question: In a certain code language, TAILOR is coded as 538490 and LAND is coded as 4367. How will DRAIN be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic :

 
• **Random digits have been assigned to each letter. **

So,

 
• TAILOR is coded as 538490

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53180bcf252c3ae535332609157870d0fe1752da20a76a79756a8dbfbb00b3d6.png] ​

 
• LAND is coded as 4367

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bea21f9ba984779f6c466c0bcc92aff0aba12168226db05acb72742fb511c12.png] ​

Similarly, 

 
• DRAIN is coded as : As the letter 'A' is repeated in both words TAILOR and LAND, which is coded as '3'. Therefore rest of the letter's code will be same encircled above.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/021f336d3c591bfefd0f8207d2451aac1896c18efe6e9cca082e656a1e2f7d00.png] ​

Hence, **"70386"** is the correct answer.

69:T
